name: Agent 672
source: How many jobs can a person do at the same time? Someone who has 3 jobs at the same time... Police, Student, Waiter. You are working to take down a mafia gang and the best way is to infiltrate the mafia. Your family doesn't know anything, and on top of that, someone new pops up. Can you deal with all of them? The answer is hidden in Agent 672. Will you be good cop or bad cop?
translation: 一个人可以同时做多少份工作？同时身兼三份工作的人……警察、学生、服务员。你正在努力打倒一个黑手党团伙，最好的方法就是渗透到黑手党中。你的家人什么都不知道，最重要的是，新的人突然出现。你能对付所有的人吗？答案就隐藏在特工672中。你会是好警察还是坏警察？
